reviewNotes: Hosted in the home's own media folder on its website vendor's storage (stewartfuneralhome.com serves its older GPL 8-25-20 from the same folder), so provenance is posted. The printed date, July 15, 2024, is 26 months before retrieval, so the loader holds it until the home confirms it is still current.

Direct cremation: the document gives $2,316.50 to $2,416.50 and explains the $100 as the cremation approval needed when death occurs in DC or Virginia. For this DC home the observation is the DC price, $2,416.50, with the fiberboard (alternative) container, matching the FTC-comparable line used for Rhines. The purchaser-container and wood-box variants stay as ranges so the home counts once.
Embalming: the under-300-lbs. line is the observation; embalming here includes dressing, cosmetizing and casketing, so there is no separate body-preparation line.
Viewing is priced per hour ($225 for 1 hour); recorded as the viewing observation with the unit in its name.
Daily Storage Fee (every 24 hours) is the per-day shelter-of-remains fee. The matcher learned this wording in the same change (lib/negotiation/price-list-parse.ts).

Second-day hearse, limousine overtime and infant cremation are kept off their benchmarks. Immediate burial has no benchmark. Caskets, containers and urns are ranges and never enter the benchmark feed.

General Price List
The goods and services shown below are those we can provide to our customers. You may choose
only the items you desire. However, any funeral arrangements you select will include a cha rge
for our basic services and overhead. If legal or other requirements mean you must buy any items
you did not specifically ask for, we will explain the reason in writing in the statement we provide
describing the funeral goods and services you selected. The list below does not include the price
of certain items that may be added to the statement of goods and services as cash advance items
if you choose, for example death certificates, newspaper notice, flowers,  programs or cemetery
charges.

Professional Services

Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead…………………. $ 2,075.00

 Our services include conducting the arrangements conference;
planning the funeral; consulting with family and clergy; securing
a death certificate signed by the decedent’s physician;  shelter of
remains; preparing and filing of necessary notices; obtaining
necessary authorizations and permits; and coordinating with the
cemetery, crematory, or other third parties . In addition, this fee
includes a proportionate share of our basic overhead costs.

 This fee for our basic services and overhead will be added to the
total cost of the funeral arrangements you select . (This fee is
already included in our charges for direct cremations, immediate
burials, and forwarding remains.)

Embalming…………………………………………... cases under 300 lbs. $ 1,715.00
 …………………………………….... cases over 301 lbs. $ 2,025.00

 Except in certain special cases, embalming is not required by law .
Embalming may be necessary, however, if you select certain funeral
arrangements, such as a funeral with viewing . If you do not want
embalming, you usually have the right to choose an arrangement
that does not require you to pay for it, such as direct cremation or
immediate burial . This fee includes dressing, cosmetizing and
casketing.

Other Preparations of the Remains…………………………………….……$   150.00
(per hour) additional restorative art procedures that may occur from
a traumatic death or disease and decedents who are more than 350
pounds.

Transfer of Remains to Funeral Home (within 25-mile radius) ……………$   425.00
 Beyond this radius or outside city limits we charge
 $2.25 per mile

Facilities

Use of Facilities and Staff for Viewing…… (1 hour) ……………………. $ 225.00

Use of Facilities and Staff for Funeral Ceremony at the Funeral Home…. $ 600.00

Daily Storage Fee………….…every 24 hours ………………….…………$ 100.00

Automotive Equipment

Hearse……………………………………………………………………. $ 525.00
2nd Day Hearse Use………………………………………………………. $ 445.00

Limousine……………7 passenger $550.00
Limousine Overtime (Limousine use after 4 hours) …………. …. $ 100.00 per hour

Service Car (Sedan) ………………………………………………………$325.00

Merchandise

Caskets………………………………………………………$995.00 to $ 35,000.00
 A complete price list will be provided at the funeral home.

Outer Burial Containers…………………………………….$ 1,275.00 to $ 4,500.00
 A complete price list will be provided at the funeral home.

Urns………………………………………………….…………$ 75.00 to $ 6,700.00
Complete pricing information will be provided at the funeral home.

Acknowledgement Cards (25 per box) $20.00                          Register Book $45.00

Other Services

Forwarding of Remains to Another Funeral Home…………….…………$ 2,150.00.
 Our charge includes basic services of funeral director and staff; a
proportionate share of overhead cost; removal of remains;
embalming or other preparation of remains, if relevant; and local
transportation.

Receiving Remains from Another Funeral Home……………………. …. $ 1,595.00
 Our charge includes basic services of funeral director and staff; a
proportionate share of overhead cost; care of remains; transportation
of remains to funeral home and cemetery or crematory (no viewing
or funeral service at funeral home or church).

Direct Cremation…………………………………...…...……$2,316.50 to $ 2,416.50
 Our charge for a direct cremation (without ceremony) includes basic
services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of
overhead cost; removal of remains; cremation container (fiberboard
container); transportation to crematory; necessary authorizations;
and cremation if relevant.

Direct Cremation for an Infant younger than 12 months...………….………. $600.00
 (Includes the same services provided for direct cremation of an
adult.)

 If you want to arrange a direct cremation, you can use an alternative
container. Alternative containers encase the body and can be made
of materials like fiberboard or composition materials  (with or
without an outside covering) . The containers we provide are a
fiberboard container or an unfinished wood box.

       A. Direct cremation with container provided by the
                                purchaser………………………………. $1,800.00 to $1,900.00

        B.  Direct cremation with an unfinished wood
              box……………………………………...$2,233.00 to $2,333.00.

**There is a difference of $ 100.00 in the range of service for adult
cremation. This cost is cremation approval that is needed when a decedent
passes in Virginia or the District of Columbia.

Cremains Disposal Fee…………………………………………….…………$275.00

Immediate Burial

 Our charge for an immediate burial (without ceremony) includes
basic services of funeral director and staff; a proportionate share of
overhead cost; removal and local transportation to cemetery.

 A.  Immediate burial with casket provided by purchaser. $2,020.00
 B.  Immediate burial with alternative container ……….... $2,603.00
 C.  Immediate burial with cloth covered wood casket….... $3,074.70

Thank you for your consideration.
We sincerely hope to serve you.

Family Owned and Operated

Stewart Funeral Home,
Inc.
